de: With the church leadership driven out of Rome during an armed conflict, Pius VII is crowned Pope in Venice with a temporary papal tiara made of papier-mâché.

te: The United States Library of Congress is established when President John Adams signs legislation to appropriate $5,000 …
dz: 美国国会图书馆是在约翰·亚当斯总统签署立法拨款 5,000 美元购买“国会使用可能需要的书籍”时成立的。
de: The United States Library of Congress is established when President John Adams signs legislation to appropriate $5,000 to purchase "such books as may be necessary for the use of Congress".

de: The 6th United States Congress recesses, and the process of moving the Federal government of the United States from Philadelphia to Washington, D.C., begins the following day.

de: War of the Second Coalition: Battle of Höchstädt results in a French victory over Austria.

de: The French garrison in Valletta surrenders to British troops who had been called at the invitation of the Maltese. The islands of Malta and Gozo become the Malta Protectorate.

de: United States presidential election: The Electoral College casts votes for president and vice president that result in a tie between Thomas Jefferson and Aaron Burr.

t: 霍亨林登战役:法国将领让·维克多·玛丽·莫罗在慕尼黑附近决定性地击败了奥地利的约翰大公. 再加…
te: Battle of Hohenlinden: French General Jean Victor Marie Moreau decisively defeats the Archduke John of Austria near Mun…
dz: 第二联军之战:霍亨林登战役:法国将领让·维克多·玛丽·莫罗在慕尼黑附近决定性地击败了奥地利的约翰大公. 再加上第一执政官拿破仑·波拿巴先前在马伦戈的胜利,这将迫使奥地利人签署停战协议并结束战争.
de: War of the Second Coalition: Battle of Hohenlinden: French General Jean Victor Marie Moreau decisively defeats the Archduke John of Austria near Munich. Coupled with First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte's earlier victory at Marengo, this will force the Austrians to sign an armistice and end the war.
